summary: Grayscale Bitcoin Cash Trust (BCH) filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting a routine change by CoinDesk Indices, Inc. to the digital asset trading platforms used to calculate the Index Price for the Trust. As of June 16, 2026, OKX (BCH-USDC trading pair) was added during a scheduled monthly review; no platforms were removed. The filing is an ordinary operational update with no corporate event, deal, or strategic action involving acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other special situation.
